verdict: Organic presence holding, but visibility is slipping across all three entities.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all activity this period came entirely from organic local presence — no paid campaigns are running on any channel. Combined, the three businesses generated 380 Google Business Profile actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks) over the last 28 days, which is the full picture of inbound intent. That said, GBP engagement declined meaningfully in the last 7 days across every entity — down 50% at Forte, 30% at Advance Grinding, and 37% at O'Hare — and search click trends are confirming the same direction. The SEO and web root-cause work is in motion and remains the critical lever for reversing this; once that fix is submitted and the contact and CRM reconciliation items are resolved, outreach sequences and reindexing will follow. Next period, the focus is closing the overdue infrastructure items so that organic recovery has a clean foundation to build on.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
calls received across all three entities this period, entirely from organic local search
average decline in GBP engagement over the last 7 days versus the prior 7, across all entities

watch_item.issue: GBP visibility dropped sharply in the final days of this period — the last two to three days show near-zero actions and search clicks across all three locations, confirmed as a real decline and not seasonal noise. Two O'Hare profiles (Precision Ground Metals and Precision Ground Bars) are also recording zero calls despite active impressions, indicating a call tracking issue on both listings.
watch_item.fix: The web and SEO root-cause fix is being finalized for submission, and the call button issue on the two affected profiles is being investigated and corrected now.
